issues.claim: Community Dental of North Brunswick, 566 Milltown Rd (listed as an independent practice)
issues.problem: Its own site shows it is one office of a multi-office New Jersey Community Dental group (Burlington, Lawnside, Hamilton, Sicklerville, Salem/Pennsville, Little Egg Harbor, Somers Point, Ventnor, plus North Brunswick) - well past the mapper's own 5+ office chain rule, so it is an excluded type.
issues.fix: Drop the entry, or move it to an explicitly labelled 'chain - excluded' list so nobody approaches it as a local independent.

issues.claim: Maximum Health, listed as '212 North Center Drive'
issues.problem: Maximum Health's own locations page lists 6 offices (Kenilworth, North Brunswick, Rockaway, Ledgewood, Raritan, Piscataway), all co-located with Retro Fitness or another gym chain. Per the mapper's 5+ office rule this is a chain and should not be in the list. The same page also gives the address as 223 North Center Dr, not the 212 used in the entry.
issues.fix: Remove the entry as a chain (or flag it clearly); if kept for any reason, correct the address to 223 North Center Dr and the phone to 732-658-6111.

issues.claim: Walk In Medical Center, 1901 US Highway 130, #1, phone (732) 658-1102
issues.problem: The clinic's own contact page gives 1901 Rt 130 South, North Brunswick, with phones 917-731-7353 and 862-371-4450; a Wellpoint provider directory gives 732-348-8125. The listed (732) 658-1102 is not corroborated anywhere I opened, and the suite/side of the highway ('#1' vs 'Suite D', South) differs.
issues.fix: Re-check the number against the business's own contact page before any call; correct to 917-731-7353 (or 862-371-4450) and the address to 1901 Route 130 South, Suite D.

issues.claim: Delicate Dental of North Brunswick, phone 'Unknown'
issues.problem: A phone is publicly listed - (732) 297-0549 on a CareCredit provider page - so the 'Unknown' is an avoidable gap in a list otherwise strong on phone numbers.
issues.fix: Fill in (732) 297-0549, flagged as a directory-sourced number to confirm on first contact.

issues.claim: Pediatrician coverage (only Farrington Pediatrics, My Whole Child, Better Pediatrics, HNR Ruth Rd, Dr. Meetu Soni-adjacent listings)
issues.problem: Three North Brunswick pediatric practices surfaced in a single search and are absent: North Brunswick Pediatrics (1598 US Highway 130 Ste D, (732) 630-3745), Naqui and Naqui Medical Group (1574 US Highway 130, (732) 297-4100 - same address and phone as the listed Farrington Pediatrics entry, so one of the two names is wrong or they share a suite), and HNR Pediatrics' second North Brunswick office at 1300 How Lane, (732) 247-1510 (the existing HNR entry names only the Ruth Rd office).
issues.fix: Add North Brunswick Pediatrics; resolve whether Farrington Pediatrics and Naqui & Naqui are the same office; add the How Lane HNR office to the HNR entry.

issues.problem: Two practices on the cited ranking list, and confirmed on their own sites, are missing: Kids Care Dental Associates (570 Georges Rd, (732) 565-0511, 3 offices so under the chain threshold) and Brunswick Periodontal Associates (1254 State Highway 27, (732) 846-6366). Kids Care is also the town's obvious pediatric-dentistry independent now that Tender Smiles is excluded.
issues.fix: Add both, with kcdanj.com and brunswickperio.com as their websites.

issues.claim: Chiropractic coverage (Maximum Health, Network Chiropractic, Potter, Healthquest, Nemser, plus the three practices with their own sites)
issues.problem: Advanced Chiropractic & Health Center (Dr. Kevin Lynch), 1440 How Lane Suite 2A, (732) 246-4900, appears on the same directory the mapper used for other entries and is missing.
issues.fix: Add Advanced Chiropractic & Health Center from its BestProsInTown profile.

issues.problem: Eyes by Dr. Bonnie, 101 Grand Ave, (732) 297-5413, surfaced in an optometrist search and is not listed; the caveat that 'no further independent optometrists surfaced' is therefore optimistic.
issues.fix: Verify and add Eyes by Dr. Bonnie, or note it as checked-and-rejected with a reason.

issues.claim: Website field left blank on ~15 entries that do have their own sites
issues.problem: Own sites exist and were not recorded for at least: Hidden Lake Dental Associates (hiddenlakedental.org), Cornerstone Orthodontics (cornerstoneorthonj.com), Somerset Eye Care (somerseteyecare.com), Family Eye Care & Contact Lens (almajacobsenod.com), Dhyana Yoga (dhyanayogawellness.com), Inspire Physical Therapy (theinspirept.com), SmileBrite (smilebriteusa.com), Community Dental (communitydentalnj.com), Genesis Salon and Spa (genesissalonspa.info), Farrington Pediatrics (farringtonpediatrics.com).
issues.fix: Populate the website field from these domains; it materially improves outreach preparation for the same entries.
